title.title: Log abundance in characteristic zero, every dimension
title.subtitle: Claim: for every lc pair $(X,B)$ in characteristic 0, if $K_X+B$ is nef it is semiample

plain: If a shape's built-in curvature is never negative, some multiple of it maps the shape onto a simpler one

panels.caption: dimension of $X$: green known before, violet claimed

beats.text: Abundance was known for surfaces and threefolds; from dimension 4, even nonvanishing was open
The induction imports other release results as finished theorems
Dashed: unrefereed release papers. Grey: published prior work

steps: Known up to dimension three: surfaces and threefolds
Prove nonvanishing and minimal models together, one dimension up
A new signed boundary test makes every step work
